def _create_temp_tree(tmp_path):
    """
    Create a minimal Doorstop tree in a temporary directory.
    Returns the Tree instance and the path to the root directory.
    """
    # Create a simple document file
    doc_path = tmp_path / "REQ001.md"
    doc_path.write_text(
        """# REQ001
---
id: REQ001
title: Sample requirement
---
This is a sample requirement.
"""
    )
    # Build the tree
    t = builder.build(cwd=str(tmp_path))
    return t, str(tmp_path)
